# Basehome network topology

**Updated:** 2026-09-08

Proxmox host, Kubuntu guest, Docker services, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel (Immich only), and wdred NFS. Edit topology.yaml, then re-run the renderer — do not hand-edit generated MD/HTML.

**Source of truth:** [`topology.yaml`](./topology.yaml) · **Scan page:** [`topology.html`](./topology.html) · Regenerate: `python3 scripts/render-topology.py`

## Tree

```
Internet → ISP router (192.168.11.1)
              └─ LAN 192.168.11.0/24
                    ├─ Proxmox pve (192.168.11.123, TS 100.91.123.54)
                    │     └─ USB wdred 3.7T at /mnt/pve/wdred
                    │           ├─ pve (host-only)
                    │           ├─ NFS maktaba/media → maktaba VM
                    │           ├─ NFS shared → maktaba VM
                    │           ├─ NFS shared/immich/library → maktaba VM
                    │           └─ NFS immich/library → maktaba VM  [planned]
                    └─ Kubuntu maktaba VM (192.168.11.141, TS 100.68.38.53)
                          ├─ Jellyfin: http://player.maktaba.home
                          ├─ TubeArchivist: http://yt.maktaba.home
                          ├─ Vaultwarden: https://vault.maktaba.home
                          ├─ dnsmasq: *.maktaba.home
                          ├─ Immich: https://photos.homz.fyi · https://photos.maktaba.home
                          ├─ Homepage [planned]: https://home.maktaba.home
                          └─ Forgejo [planned]: https://git.maktaba.home
```

## Edge (Caddy)

| Proxy | Binds | TLS | Sites |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| maktaba-caddy | `:80` | — | player.maktaba.home → jellyfin:8096; yt.maktaba.home → tubearchivist:8000; docs.maktaba.home → file_server /srv/docs |
| vaultwarden-caddy | `:443` | internal CA | vault.maktaba.home → vaultwarden:80; photos.maktaba.home → immich_server:2283; home.maktaba.home → homepage:3000 [planned]; git.maktaba.home → forgejo:3000 [planned] |
| Cloudflare Tunnel (maktaba-immich) | `cloudflared in Immich compose` | Cloudflare edge (Access on all paths) | photos.homz.fyi → immich_server:2283 |

## DNS

- **Domain:** `maktaba.home`
- **Mode:** Tailscale split DNS
- **Nameserver:** `100.68.38.53`
- dnsmasq on maktaba binds LAN + Tailscale IP
- All *.maktaba.home → 100.68.38.53
- Router DHCP DNS to maktaba is optional; Tailscale is primary for owned devices

## Remote access

- **Default:** Tailscale mesh (no port-forward). Immich also public via Cloudflare Tunnel + Access at photos.homz.fyi — Vaultwarden stays Tailscale-only.

- **Not exposed to internet:** Jellyfin, TubeArchivist, Vaultwarden, Homepage, Forgejo
- See also: [`docs/vaultwarden/remote-access.md`](../vaultwarden/remote-access.md)

## Invariants

- No new public-facing service without a REGISTRY row
- Do not expose app ports on the ISP router; Tailscale first (Immich public path is Tunnel + Access only)
- Immich tunnel must never publish Vaultwarden or other services — photos.homz.fyi only
- Only Proxmox mounts the USB block device; guests use NFS
- NFS exports restricted to 192.168.11.141 (not whole LAN)
- Postgres / ES / Redis stay on VM disk — never on NFS
- No secrets in basehome-ops git
